answer: `--tone-danger-soft` is the variable for the soft background shade of the danger tone. It is the `-soft` variant of `--tone-danger`, meant for backgrounds.

[1] Space Style.md (Load order)
  Tone colours: SilverBullet defines six tones as CSS variables, with values for the light and the dark theme: `--tone-success`, `--tone-warning`, `--tone-danger`, `--tone-info`, `--tone-neutral` and `--tone-accent`. Each has a `-soft` variant for backgrounds (for example `--tone-danger-soft`). Your own styles can use them to stay readable in both themes: / ```css / .overdue { / color: var(--tone-danger); / background: var(--tone-danger-soft); / } / ```
